text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess hasn't shown up for training, so I ask around before heading out to look for her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Look at these beefed up aesthetics! I can see why King had such high praise for this art exhibition! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ With this, I'm another step closer to becoming the noblest of ladies, just like her.
choice_data_list: I'm pretty sure King would never forget about practice.
I'm pretty sure King would never forget about practice.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, clearly! King would never do something so stup—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer? What're you doing here? And what's that about prac…tice?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ack! I-I-I had practice today, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! It completely slipped my mind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess seems truly remorseful about her mistake. I warn her that while self-improvement is all well and good, training should be her top priority.
